'''Delvin Constructs''' was a supplier of cheap and easily-constructed prefabricated building designs throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] for [[Standard year/Legends|years]]. Their pre-manufactured buildings were used by various military forces of the galaxy, most notably during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
